trap-superlative.evidence: Four unqualified maxima in three consecutive sentences: the mass 'breaks CLEANLY into six derived terms'; 'EVERY term evaluates UNIQUELY from the canonical braid word and substrate parameter'; 'The formulation STRICTLY enforces the Markov trace invariance across ALL observables'; 'The breakdown identifies EXACTLY the origin of isospin and parity violations'.
trap-superlative.notes: REFUTED BY THE BLOCK'S OWN SIBLING TABLE, which marks Terms 2 and 3 'PATHOLOGICAL at q_0 archimedean' — two of the six do not evaluate at the substrate, so 'cleanly' and 'every term evaluates uniquely' are false as written; the table also qualifies Term 5 as Markov-invariant only 'within sign list', against 'strictly ... across all observables'. The .ts nonetheless sets computation.status = verified. PROPOSED: state the six-term split and say which terms are archimedean-pathological, rather than claiming uniform evaluation. THREE FURTHER NON-TRAP FINDINGS. (i) DIMENSIONS: only Term 4 carries an explicit m_e; if m(rho) is in MeV then Terms 1, 2, 3 and 6 are dimensionless traces being added to an MeV quantity, and if every term is implicitly in m_e units then Term 4's explicit m_e is redundant. No unit convention is stated. (ii) UNDEFINED z AND UNSTATED CONVENTION: Term 3 carries a factor z^2 with z never defined in the block. If it is the Markov parameter, the block does not say which convention, and convention D (z = q^3/(q^2+1) = 0.6126880371) is canonical while C (z = sqrt q/(q+1) = 0.4993203342) is excised. I cannot tell from the block which is meant and am reporting it as unstated rather than guessing; z^2 differs by a factor 1.506 between them (0.37536 vs 0.24932). (iii) With the explicit m_e, m(rho) reads as an absolute MeV mass, excised as a framework prediction on 2026-08-11. Also: the sibling table's computation column is sweep-damaged in 3 of 6 rows and cites a witness file that does not exist — see the verdict recorded there.
